pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: Same photo, sent twice. Why can't you read this one?
Chat apps often shrink photos with lossy compression.
Lossy means detail is discarded for good. Tiny text suffers most.
WhatsApp's help says shared media is usually compressed, and offers HD.
In our test, the re-saved copy turned the code into a guess; the original kept it.
Fine print? Send HD, or attach it as a document, then check it.
